MINUTES OF MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN VENTURE ONE (PRIVATE) LIMITED (“COMPANY”) HELD ON ________________ 
 
 Present 
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan Chief Executive / Director 
 Adil Ahmad Kamal Director 
 
 Adil Ahmad Kamal chaired the meeting (“ Chairman ”). 
 
 Agenda 
 
 AMENDMENT TO THE LOAN AGREEMENT WITH ZAMEEN ARCS (PRIVATE) LIMITED 
 
 The Board was informed that the Company desires to extend the Termination Date of the loan extended by the Company to Zameen Arcs (Private) Limited (“ Borrower ”) under the loan agreement dated 4 April 2019, as amended by the Amendment dated 3 April 2020 (collectively, the “ Loan Agreement ”), to 30 June 2024. 
 
 The Board unanimously nominated Adil Ahmad Kamal, Director of the Company, t o discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal. 
 
 Resolutions 
 
 After discussing the aforesaid matter in detail, the following resolutions were passed/approved/adopted by the Board: 
 
 Resolved , that the Termination Date of the loan extended to the Borrower under the Loan Agreement be extended to 30 June 2024. 
 
 Resolved further, that Adil Ahmad Kamal be and is hereby authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

 Company Secretary
